I'm your host, Darren Van Dam!

If you're looking for the best movies to watch on Prime Video this month, they just added a massive stack of top-notch flicks like Gosford Park, The Jerk and my personal favorite The Wolf of Snow Hollow. There's plenty throwback movies to watch on Prime Video right now but later in May, they're also releasing a new Jack Ryan movie and the new Spider-Noir series starring Nicolas Cage as a 1920s gumshoe version of Spider-Man!

For more streaming recommendations that align with your taste stay tuned to Flick Connection for a relentless barrage of movies you've never heard of.
